landmarks.name: Hassan II Mosque
landmarks.writeup: Located in Casablanca, it is one of the largest mosques in the world, known for its stunning architecture and oceanfront location.

landmarks.name: Medina of Fez
landmarks.writeup: A UNESCO World Heritage site, this ancient walled city is famous for its narrow alleys, traditional markets, and historic buildings.

landmarks.name: Ait Benhaddou
landmarks.writeup: A fortified village (ksar) along the former caravan route between the Sahara and Marrakech, known for its earthen clay architecture.

landmarks.name: Jemaa el-Fnaa
landmarks.writeup: A vibrant square in Marrakech famous for its street performers, food stalls, and traditional Moroccan culture.

landmarks.name: Atlas Mountains
landmarks.writeup: A mountain range offering diverse landscapes, traditional Berber villages, and opportunities for trekking and skiing.

cultural_events.name: Mawazine Festival
cultural_events.writeup: An annual music festival in Rabat showcasing international and Moroccan artists, promoting cultural exchange.

cultural_events.name: Fes Festival of World Sacred Music
cultural_events.writeup: Celebrates spiritual music from various cultures, held in the historic city of Fez.

cultural_events.name: Imilchil Marriage Festival
cultural_events.writeup: A traditional Berber festival in the Atlas Mountains where local tribes gather for matchmaking and celebrations.

food_writeup: Moroccan cuisine is known for its rich flavors and use of spices such as cumin, saffron, and cinnamon. Signature dishes include tagine, couscous, and pastilla, often combining sweet and savory elements.
brief_history: Morocco has a rich history influenced by indigenous Berber, Arab, and European cultures. It was a French and Spanish protectorate until gaining independence in 1956. The country has a constitutional monarchy and has played a significant role in regional politics.

important_people.name: Fatima al-Fihri
important_people.description: Founder of the world's oldest university, University of Al Quaraouiyine

current_conflicts: Ongoing territorial dispute over Western Sahara between Morocco and the Sahrawi Arab Democratic Republic (SADR).
